owner.sourceExample: New rules should not shut the door on collaboration.
owner.sense: A policy or choice blocks an external opportunity, access or cooperation.

proposedAlias.sourceExpression: emotionally, they start shutting the door
proposedAlias.sourceExample: If they feel judged, emotionally, they start shutting the door.
proposedAlias.construction: shutting the door with no on-complement, under an emotional context
proposedAlias.sense: Children withdraw or withhold thoughts and feelings after perceived judgement.

assessment: Shared door imagery does not establish the same teachable lexical construction or decision. The 3413 lesson teaches an object-bearing shut the door on + opportunity; the 3672 line teaches emotional withdrawal without an object. Broadening 3413 to any bare shut the door would admit common literal closing and would not teach the emotional-withholding cue. The 3672 source sentence is also stilted English, so a new high-confidence canonical lesson from it is premature.

recommendation.reason: Bare emotional shutting the door denotes withdrawing feelings after judgement, not the source 3413 object-bearing shut the door on + opportunity. Avoid aliasing across this construction/sense boundary or widening the owner regex to literal closures. Hold pending native editorial decision on teachable natural form.
